description: 인천광역시_도로_위험 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천광역시. 인천광역시가 제공하는 인천 도로 위험 조회 API는 관내 도로에서 발생하는 위험 요소 및 사고 다발 지역에 대한 공간 및 속성 데이터를 제공합니다. Coverage: 인천광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 인천광역시. Its tags are 사고, 도로, 위험, 안전, 예방. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-11-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
